description.value:
Budget Arms once produced quality iron, including decent machine pistols. The Mox obtained cases of these 'Laser Niners' and customized them for their needs, balancing a harmless appearance with the ability to confront Maelstrom psychos or corporate threats. Thus, the 'Heartbreaker' prioritizes rapid point-blank target acquisition over all else.

Cost: 1,300eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 33 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild, Reflex Sight • Mods: None

Special Features: If this weapon is wielded or drawn during the first Round of Combat, the user’s current Initiative increases by 1, which persists as long as the weapon remains wielded and is being actively utilized (just holding it at your side doesn’t count) [Reflex Sight].

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild, Reflex Sight (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
